gap: No result ChatGPT got (of the six I could read) states that the Lofree Flow 2 84 for Mac comes to $127.20 at checkout on 2026-11-21 against the $159.00 page price ChatGPT quoted, which puts it under the Logitech MX Mechanical Mini for Mac at $129.99 and the NuPhy Air75 V3 at $139.95, while the Keychron K3 Max is $72.49 at Keychron, not the $87.49 and $109.99 ChatGPT showed.
standout_why: Compared against mechkeyfoundry's two pages (October 2026 list prices only: K3 Max $109.99, Air75 V3 $139.95, Flow 2 $159.00, MX Mechanical Mini $159.99, no sale or checkout prices), mkbguide's low-profile page (tier symbols only, no dollar prices, though thorough on height, travel and battery), techwisereviews (no prices) and enzosoler (dated 2026-11-21: has Logitech's $129.99 sale price and a Keychron K2 Max sale price, but no Lofree and no K3 Max). None carries Lofree's in-cart 20% or today's K3 Max price. It stops short of 3 because enzosoler already has part of today's pricing, the finding lasts only as long as the sales, and the cited RTINGS page came back as navigation only, so I could not check it.
decides: It confirms the Keychron K3 Max as the value pick, by a wider margin than ChatGPT showed ($72.49 listing price at Keychron). It changes the Lofree Flow 2 84 for Mac from the dearest of ChatGPT's four at $159.00 to cheaper than the Logitech MX Mechanical Mini for Mac ($129.99) and the NuPhy Air75 V3's main Amazon listings ($139.95) while Lofree's sale runs, so it can honestly place top three as the Mac-layout aluminum pick. Two caveats: two Air75 V3 Amazon listings were $111.96, below the Flow 2's checkout total, and the Lofree Flow Lite 2 84 at $87.20 through our link still costs more than the K3 Max, so it does not win on budget.
